answer: Require each agent to post a small refundable bond in a ferrous, tamper-evident ledger before it can wander between marketplaces. A nebula of throwaway identities then costs a bond apiece, while honest agents recover theirs after a season of clean attestations. Sybil farming becomes a capital problem: every fake pays upfront, bonds of caught cheaters are burned, and the cost of one more identity stays constant instead of dropping to zero.
